browserChecks: All five skills produce damage and VFX
Cast and impact audio including three lightning chain sounds
validation.pdf: Seven pages rendered to PNG with Poppler and visually reviewed; no clipping or overlapping content observed.
validation.economy: Nine unit tests passed; browser checked purchases, upgrades, sales, replacements, training exclusion, full wave rewards and mobile layout.
validation.monsterBrowserChecks: Live damage for three combos, training isolation and model picker, natural wave-10 roster spawn and boss HUD, injected lethal damage to validate boss/wave gold, wave-11 family switch, boss escape damage, mobile overflow, and natural wave 1 completed with 12 kills and 20 base HP using a level-3 earth tower.
validation.databaseBrowserChecks: 15 tower forms and 56 monster forms; orbit/zoom/reset, geometry framing, Thai search and empty state, URL restoration, wave input limits, 320/390/768px layout, battlefield navigation and mobile header.

campaignSimulation.method: Actual browser simulation steps; UI purchase/upgrade transactions between waves; no injected rewards or forced damage

monsters.afterWave50: Playable campaign finishes with victory; higher-wave values are hypothetical Database calculations.
monsters.visualStyle: Smooth cartoon models with Phong surfaces, soft specular highlights, thin dark outlines, rounded equipment and species-specific joint animation
monsters.geometry: Shared immutable sphere/capsule/rounded-box/curved-tube geometry cached per factory
monsters.animations: Shared animateMonster for Database and battlefield; slime squash/bounce, rat paws/ears/tail, spider eight-leg gait, humanoid hip/shoulder gait, zombie forward arms, magic rune orbit
monsters.shieldRule: Armored humanoids only; Slime, Rat and Spider use helmets without shields. Boss Slime scale is unchanged.
monsters.humanoidArtDirection: User-provided goblin reference: oversized heads, stocky compact bodies, large hands/feet, leather adventurer outfits, expressive faces; species-specific skull/undead/brute details.
monsters.zombieArtDirection: Independent undead human: gaunt oval face, uneven sunken/cloudy eyes, sparse hair, stitches, crooked mouth/missing teeth, ragged blue-grey shirt, one boot/one bare foot, forward arms and dragging gait; no goblin fangs/brows or adventurer satchel/strap.
monsters.skeletonArtDirection: Independent open bone anatomy: recessed skull sockets/nose, separate jaw/teeth, curved ribs/spine/pelvis, paired limb bones, bony hands/feet, shaped steel sword; no adventurer outfit.
monsters.orcArtDirection: Independent brute warrior: broad shoulders/chest, square jaw, narrow amber eyes, curved tusks, compact ears, shoulder spikes, iron bracers/knee guards, heavy boots and double-headed battle axe; slower heavy gait, no adventurer satchel.
monsters.wave40: Skeleton and Zombie together; each 60% full boss HP and 50% reward
